texts.preamble: Braj Kumar Shukla vs State Of U.P. And Anr. on 19 February, 2025 Author: Subhash Chandra Sharma Bench: Subhash Chandra Sharma High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench ?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc-Lko:10712 Court No. - 14 Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 1507 of 2016 Applicant :- Braj Kumar Shukla Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And Anr. Counsel for Applicant :- Pradyumn Shukla Counsel for Opposite Party :- Govt. Advocate Hon'ble Subhash Chandra Sharma,J. 1.
texts.facts: It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that in this case, sample of Tata salt was taken from the shop of the applicant on which batch number and lot number was not mentioned. The sample was sent to Government Public Analyst Lucknow who submitted its Report No. 14490 dated 24.01.2005 in which it was found that there was no any adulteration in the sample but as per rule 32(e) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Rules, 1955, batch/lot number was not mentioned. On account of violation of its rule, present complaint was filed against the applicant on the basis of which cognizance was taken by the learned court concerned and summoning order was passed on 05.08.2008. 4. It is further submitted that there was no any adulteration found in the sample but only non-mention of batch/lot number of the packet cannot be said to be an offence under the Act/Rules.
texts.arguments: He relied on his arguments in the case of M/s Flavorad India Thru Prop. (Complaint Case) Vs. The state of U.P. and another in Case No. U/s 482/378/407 No. 207 of 2013 decided by this Court on 17.04.2013 relying on the judgment passed by Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Dwarka Nath and another Vs. The Municipal Corporation of Delhi. In para nos. 8 and 9 of the aforesaid judgment as quoted below: "8. 9. Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in Dwarka Nath case (supra) has held thus in para 23 : "There is no definition of the expression "batch number" or "code number" either in the Act or the Rules. 6. Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer as aforesaid but could not dispute the legal position as held by Hon'ble Supreme Court and followed by this Court.
